$comment: The single definition of the language ecosystems proofline knows (A173). Every script reads this file: bin/lib/discover.sh (command discovery), skills/verify-proof/scripts/runtime-versions.sh (runtime versions) and, later, the review, dependency, design, visual, performance and TDD checks. Adding an ecosystem is one object in `ecosystems`. Never edit ecosystems.tsv by hand: `node ecosystems.mjs write` regenerates it and `node ecosystems.mjs check` fails when it differs. Shapes are documented in docs/concepts/ecosystems.md. Globs use the dialect of agent.sh (a pattern without / matches at any depth, ** spans directories, * and ? stay inside one segment). Every regular expression is written in the part that POSIX ERE and JavaScript share (no lookarounds, no \d, \s, \w, no [[:classes:]]) and is applied to one line of a file at a time, except where a source says `flatten`. A /source/flags string is a JavaScript regular expression.
